pages.transcription:
Taft Hotel
Newhaven, 19.3.41
Dear Hanna u Manfred,
I wrote twice last week, once with a letter to Jan enclosed, I hope you got the letter. In the meantime nothing much has
happened. I am up again and already cleared up a great amount of my
so long neglected work. The main part of the manuscript for the Brasil
book has been sent away at last and Stefan feels better since the piles
of paper have somewhat diminished. The weather has been dreadful all
the time, storms, snow and extreme cold, and in the 2 months of our stay in
USA we got already thoroughly tired of the winter. Nevertheless time
seems to fly away and in another few weeks I suppose we will go back
to New York and try to make up our minds what to do that is to say where
to go next. Do you realise that it is already a year almost since we se-
parated? Your letter about Bath brought everything back so clearly and made
me feel rather homesick for a while. I am glad at least that you can be
there and enjoy the products and the beauty of the garden. What a pity
that Manfred's X-Ray course is not yet finished! But I hope he will take
long weekends, we are very much concerned about it that he does. - From
Eva we hear regularly and also Mrs Sch. reports frequently, I asked
her to join a few words to Eva's letters to you now and then. We both
feel that Eva is well looked after and happy there. She has again
started her music lessons and from what she and Mrs Sch write the teachers
seem to succeed in making her enjoy it again. She has holidays in April
and I plan to take her here for a few days at least. We look forward
to having her and she loves to come, but there is nothing for her to
do in Newhaven and I am afraid she will not know what to do with
herself all day long. If it is possible with regard to time, I shall one
day take her to visit Harriet's sister Elizabeth who has a boy and a
girl in about Eva's age and who lives halfway between New York and
Groton. I have seen Elizabeth and her children but once, but in any
case it can do no harm if Eva knows someone of the family, Leo and
the other two, Marcus and Samson, who are in New York live far away
and are without interest for Eva - and myself. - Tell Lotte please how
sorry I am that I could not yet visit her children. I hope that when
we are back in Newyork again, someone will take me out there in
car, otherwise it is very long and a little complicated to get there.
Hoping to have good news from you soon,
with best love and kindest regards
to all
Lotte
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf Briefpapier des Taft Hotels. Tinte violett. Sehr gut lesbar.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr deutlich geschrieben und weist kaum Unklarheiten auf.
